rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Line 63 in send_email_notification was: 'recipient = NOTIFICATION_EMAIL or to_email'. Since NOTIFICATION_EMAIL was always set (info@theboostpad.org), this expression always evaluated to NOTIFICATION_EMAIL, causing ALL emails to be sent to the admin instead of actual recipients.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed to send directly to to_email parameter with CC to NOTIFICATION_EMAIL for admin visibility
